description: persist a joseki knowledge-base card that the calling agent authored by value: validate it, write it into the knowledge base, and open its lifecycle row at state draft so it becomes searchable.
embedding_description: Register an agent-authored joseki card so the reusable pattern becomes searchable in the knowledge base. Writes the card markdown plus a lifecycle row at initial state draft with authored-by-value provenance. The joseki key must be new; registration never overwrites an existing card.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Registration result with keys: joseki_key, status, state, knowledge_base_path
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the registration with the joseki_key, its lifecycle state, and the knowledge_base_path so the caller can reference the stored card.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The card is stored and searchable at lifecycle state draft. Continue with the next step of the current plan; state transitions beyond draft are a separate lifecycle concern.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Registering an agent-authored joseki knowledge-base card. register_authored_joseki accepts {content}; the card's JOSEKI_KEY line is its identity. Validation runs first; nothing is stored when it fails.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: the card failed hard-fail validation — the message lists every finding — or the action arguments do not conform to the schema. AlreadyRegistered: a joseki with this JOSEKI_KEY already has a lifecycle row; registration never overwrites. StorageError: the knowledge base or state write failed after validation passed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Validation failures: repair the listed findings in the authored card (validate_authored_joseki gives the same report without side effects) and resubmit. Already-registered: pick a new JOSEKI_KEY for genuinely new patterns; replacing an existing card is a lifecycle supersession, not a re-registration. Storage failures: retry once the platform reports healthy.
